Messages.Author: leviathan
Messages.Body:
I have 7 and 5 capacity vampires and another methuselah has 6 and 4 cap
guys.
the 7 cap plays balt purge, then the 5 cap plays balt purge.

on my untap, can the other methuselah send his 4 cap to torpor for the 7
cap's balt purge, and spare his 6 cap since it is older than the vampire
that played the other balt purge, or do the balt purges happen at the same
time? would it change things if the 5 cap played balt purge first?

thanks,

leviathan

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
leviathan wrote:
> I have 7 and 5 capacity vampires and another methuselah has 6 and 4 cap
> guys.
> the 7 cap plays balt purge, then the 5 cap plays balt purge.
>
> on my untap, can the other methuselah send his 4 cap to torpor for the 7
> cap's balt purge, and spare his 6 cap since it is older than the vampire
> that played the other balt purge, or do the balt purges happen at the same
> time?

You can order the effects. So you can chose to have the 5 cap trigger
first, sending the 4 cap to torpor, and then trigger the 7 cap and force
the 6 cap to go to torpor too.

> would it change things if the 5 cap played balt purge first?

No. Both BPs trigger during the same phase (untap phase), and you can
always order them however you want.

Flux
